summary: Pyxis Oncology filed a Form 8-K on September 9, 2026, furnishing (Item 7.01) and reporting (Item 8.01) updated clinical data from its ongoing global Phase 1 monotherapy trial of micvotabart pelidotin (MICVO) in 2L+ recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, with data cutoff August 18, 2026. The 5.4 mg/kg dose-cap efficacy-evaluable population (N=33) showed a 36% confirmed objective response rate (12/33), 94% disease control rate, median PFS of 6.2 months, and a 12-month overall survival probability of 79%. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, price, premium, ownership split, or regulatory clock is disclosed.
